verdict.rationale: Working Copy stores SSH identities/keys (optionally in Secure Enclave protected by Face ID/Touch ID) attached to a repository, which implies reconnecting to a saved remote doesn't require re-entering credentials, but this is git-remote SSH, not an interactive terminal session, and there's no explicit documentation of a one-tap 'connect to saved host' action or session reuse UI. Missing for 10: explicit one-tap host connection flow, interactive terminal/shell access evidence, and independent confirmation of credential-free reconnect behavior.
